yourNormal.means: What is usual for your business, worked out from your last few months. Ziira speaks up when something is well outside it.

urgentSoon.means: How quickly something needs you. Urgent means today.

notAProblem.means: Close it, and optionally tell Ziira that this is normal at a branch or for a person so it stops raising it.

watches.means: The things Ziira looks at every few hours, such as late customers or stock running out. You can switch each one off or change its limit.

watch.means: Ziira only tells you. It never changes anything.

ask.means: You can ask a staff member to explain something.

prepare.means: Ziira prepares the job, for example a draft order. A person approves it.

act.means: Ziira does small routine jobs by itself, inside limits you set. Never anything with money.

how.menu: How much Ziira does for you
how.page: How much Ziira does for you
how.pageHint: Choose how far Ziira goes when it finds something. You can change this at any time.
how.title: How much Ziira does for you
how.hint: Four steps, from only telling you to doing small jobs for you.
how.ownerOnly: Only the owner can switch this on.
how.neverMoves: Ziira never moves money. Anything to do with money, prices, credit or stock waits for a person, and everything it does is written down.

1.name: Watch
1.does: Ziira watches your business and tells you what it notices.
1.example: It tells you a customer is 45 days late. You decide what to do.
1.never: Change anything or contact anyone for you.
1.raise: Ziira will only tell you what it notices.

2.name: Ask
2.does: As well as telling you, you can ask a staff member to explain something.
2.example: A manager asks the cashier why a till was short, with one button.
2.changes: You get an "Ask someone to explain" button.
2.raise: Managers will be able to ask a named person to explain something.

3.name: Prepare
3.does: Ziira prepares the work and you approve it. A person always has the last word.
3.example: Cement ran out, so Ziira writes a draft purchase request. You check it and send it.
3.changes: A Suggestions page appears in the menu.
3.never: Send, pay or change anything without your OK.
3.raise: Ziira will prepare jobs for a person to approve. Each is done only when approved, in that person's name. Only the owner can allow this.

4.name: Act for me
4.does: Ziira also does small routine jobs on its own, inside limits you set.
4.example: It sends a polite payment reminder to a customer who is 30 days late, up to 10 a day.
4.changes: You choose what it may do under "Things Ziira may do for you".
4.never: Move money, change prices, credit limits or stock.
4.raise: Ziira may do routine jobs that involve no money on its own, only the ones you allow, with a daily limit. Only the owner can allow this.

how.lowerWithdraw: Suggestions waiting for approval are withdrawn and no new ones are prepared. Things Ziira did by itself stop. What was already done stays on record.
how.lowerRules: Ziira stops doing things by itself. Suggestions still wait for a person to approve.
how.lowerPlain: Ziira will do less from now on. Nothing already done is undone.

alerts.title: Where you hear from Ziira
alerts.hint: How Ziira reaches you: urgent alerts, your daily summary and approvals.
alerts.urgentHint: Ziira can message the right people straight away when something serious comes up. Everything else waits for the daily summary.
alerts.channelHint: Only the ways your business has set up are listed.
alerts.levelHint: Anything less than this waits for the daily summary.

levels.medium: Urgent things and things for soon

alerts.offNote: Alerts are off. You will still see everything in the app and in your daily summary.
alerts.mineHint: Each person picks how they like to be reached for alerts, the daily summary and approvals, and the quiet hours when nothing should disturb them.
